documentation.subject: Dilemma reported: ${metric.label.dilemma_id}
documentation.content:
Players reported the dilemma `${metric.label.dilemma_id}` in the last hour, for one reason or more. This email repeats every hour while it keeps getting reports. Read the reports in Cloud SQL Studio:

```sql
select r.reported_at, r.version, r.reason, r.comment, v.text
from dilemma_reports r
join dilemma_versions v on v.dilemma_id = r.dilemma_id and v.number = r.version
where r.dilemma_id = '${metric.label.dilemma_id}'
order by r.reported_at desc;
```

If a comment suggests a threat to the life or safety of someone, tell the police without delay (article 18 of the Digital Services Act).
